description: This source file defines the TemplateProcessor and associated types for processing template variables in MCP command strings, environment variables, and configurations within the MCP control plane component.

classes.name: TemplateProcessor
classes.description: Handles processing of template variables for MCP commands, environment variables, and configurations.

classes.name: TemplateVars
classes.description: Struct that holds all variables to substitute into templates, like port, directories, and alias.

methods.name: NewTemplateProcessor
methods.description: Creates a new instance of TemplateProcessor with specified project directory and verbosity setting.

methods.name: ProcessCommand
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in a command string with corresponding template variables.

methods.name: ProcessCommands
methods.description: Processes a list of command strings, replacing variables in each.

methods.name: CreateTemplateVars
methods.description: Generates TemplateVars for a given MCPServerConfig and port.

methods.name: ProcessEnvironment
methods.description: Processes environment variable map, replacing variable placeholders with actual values.
